messages:
maya: Heads-up: Orpheus9b landed on bench. We ran basic smoke and a quick long-form QA sweep. Need a crisp recommendation for GTN: int8 default vs opt-in int4 routing, plus a small routing flag snippet we can hand to infra.

diego: Summary of perf/cost from smoke (50k tokens sample):
- p95 latency: fp16 135ms, int8 120ms, int4 110ms
- throughput: int4 slightly higher (~8%)
- unit cost estimate: fp16 $0.0015/token, int8 $0.0009/token, int4 $0.00058/token
(note: numbers include batching and conservative KV-cache savings)

lina-qa: Quality quicknotes: on our longform QA slice (>512 tokens) exact-match delta int8->int4 = -6.4% absolute; hallucination +2.1 percentage points. For short completions (<=64 tokens) diff is ~0.4% EM. Regression concentrated on retrieval-heavy and multi-reference answers.

sam: Practical GTN guidance: default route to int8 for safety. Offer a low-cost int4 opt-in for short-prompt, non-critical flows (search snippets, status messages). Canary int4 for targeted slices only.

aj: Ops tip: enable KV-cache warmstarts for the priming-heavy routes — this narrows the quality gap and reduces effective token spend for long prompts. Also consider a small-batch mixed-precision trial where top layers remain int8.

maya: Can someone draft a minimal flag that infra/PMs can flip? Keep it simple: short-prompt percentage + fallback.

diego: Draft routing JSON (proto):

```json
{
  "routing": [
    { "id": "short_optin", "match": "tokens <= 64 && metadata.flow=='low_cost'", "model": "orpheus9b-int4", "sample_rate": 0.05 },
    { "id": "default", "model": "orpheus9b-int8", "sample_rate": 0.95 }
  ],
  "fallbacks": [
    { "from": "orpheus9b-int4", "to": "orpheus9b-int8", "triggers": ["quality_drop", "latency_spike"] }
  ]
}
```

maya: Nice. ops-bot, any constraints on deploying a 5% canary to Dedicated tomorrow?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled to eng-dedicated-orpheus at 03:00 UTC (2h window). Auto-rollback if: >2% regression on any primary slice metric or >20% p95 latency increase.

sam: GTN blurb draft: "Recommend default orpheus9b-int8 for general use; enable targeted int4 opt-in for short, low-risk flows to capture ~20-35% unit-cost savings. Hold int4 out of longform / retrieval-critical routes until QA mitigations (cache warmstarts, adapter/PL-mixed quant) reduce recall loss."

lina-qa: Canary testplan: slices = [short snippets <=64, multi-turn assistant (history 3), longform QA >512]. Metrics: exact-match, hallucination rate, p95 latency, token-cost delta. AB run 24h, pivot tables and per-slice deltas. Auto-alert if EM drop >2% on any slice.

aj: If longform gap persists, experiment: keep first and last few transformer blocks in int8 and middle blocks int4. Small variant can be trialled on bench to measure EM recovery vs cost delta.

diego: I'll open the routing-flag PR and include the proto snippet + metrics to watch.

maya: I'll monitor the canary, ready to roll back if thresholds trip. Ping me with PR link and lina's CSV when ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:
